pages.title: Calculated Carnage
pages.creator: Calculate Carnage
pages.description:
Calculated Carnage puts you in command of a tank in turn-based artillery battles. Set the firing angle and shot power, account for the wind, and send shells over the hills toward enemy tanks. Explosions destroy parts of the terrain, changing the landscape as the fight continues. A shot therefore affects both your target and the ground around it.

The campaign spans at least 100 missions across 16 worlds and includes 19 boss encounters. You can also take on friends online or share one device for a battle. The central challenge is judging each trajectory while adapting your aim to a battlefield that changes with the bombardment.

pages.title: Build a Rollercoaster: Simulator
pages.creator: Square Dino LLC
pages.description: Design a coaster and ride your own track in Build a Rollercoaster: Simulator. Buy track pieces, look for rare sections, and put them together to make a longer ride. Take the coaster out once you've built a route and see how the sections feel in motion. Then change the layout and ride it again.

pages.title: Bolts - Unscrew It
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Free wooden boards by moving their bolts in Bolts - Unscrew It. Unscrew a bolt and park it in an empty hole, keeping some space available for the fasteners you still need to move. A careless transfer can leave a board trapped. Plan the order of the moves or use a booster when you get stuck.

pages.title: Stick Kill 3D
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Line up pistol shots in Stick Kill 3D. Check where the enemies stand and choose an angle that lets you take them out. Each stage is a shooting puzzle, so think about the layout before firing. Later levels demand more precise aim and give you different positions to work around.

pages.title: Squarehead Hero
pages.creator: BlackMoon Design
pages.description: Explore a dungeon one turn at a time in Squarehead Hero. Move across the grid, fight monsters, and pick up treasure or equipment for the next encounter. Look at what is near the hero before you choose a square. Decide when to collect loot and when to deal with an enemy first.

pages.title: Color Dots Challenge
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Connect and match colored dots in Color Dots Challenge. Look at how the pieces are positioned and choose a move that lets matching colors come together. Check what remains after a group clears so you can set up the next match. Work toward clearing the board and building your score.

pages.title: Merge Pixel
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: Combine matching pixel characters in Merge Pixel. Each pair turns into a higher-level character, giving you a new piece to match. Look for duplicates among the characters you've already created and keep combining them to reach higher tiers. The aim is to build up to a legendary character.

pages.title: Sniper Team 3
pages.creator: Xform
pages.description: Switch among members of your squad in Sniper Team 3. Take on waves of enemies with scoped rifles and heavier assault weapons, and call in tactical airstrikes when the fight calls for one. Watch which positions are under pressure so you can move between teammates and cover different parts of the mission.

pages.title: Serious Head
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Build defenses and hold off monsters in Serious Head. Buy defensive structures, recharge your energy, and upgrade weapons between fights. Watch for bosses among the waves and use the equipment you've built up to defeat them. Survive until the final day and close the portals.

pages.title: Tower Defense
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Place defensive towers and repel attackers in Tower Defense. Different towers have different abilities, so think about which type to unlock and where it can cover the route. Improve your soldiers as the attacks grow more demanding. Use the crossbow yourself to help stop enemies that get through your defenses.

pages.title: Cyberpunk Agent
pages.creator: Ohayō
pages.description: Fight zombies to protect civilians in Cyberpunk Agent. Move through the missions and pay attention to where the zombies are advancing before taking your next shot. The goal is to stop them from reaching the people in danger. Clear each encounter as you work through the outbreak.

pages.title: Warfront
pages.creator: Y-rec
pages.description: Take part in tactical first-person combat in Warfront. Assemble a team and work through the levels, balancing where you move with when you take a shot. Develop your abilities and upgrade your character as you progress. Use the team you've put together to take on the next fight.

pages.title: Mega Ramp Bike Racing Tracks
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Ride a motorcycle along elevated stunt tracks in Mega Ramp Bike Racing Tracks. Line up each approach so the bike is positioned for the next ramp or narrow stretch. Build speed where the route gives you room and keep the motorcycle steady through the stunt. Work through the courses without losing control.

pages.title: Army Defence Dino Shoot
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Keep dinosaurs away from your base in Army Defence Dino Shoot. Summon soldiers and engineers to build a defensive line, then improve your weapons, damage, or firing rate. More dinosaurs arrive the longer you hold the position. Decide which upgrade will help most before the next attackers close in.

pages.title: Screw It Out Jam! - Matching Colored Screws
pages.creator: boooogiegames
pages.description: Sort fasteners into matching toolboxes in Screw It Out Jam! - Matching Colored Screws. Check the color of the box that arrives and tap screws of that color to send them into it. Watch for a new toolbox before choosing the next group. Keep matching screws until you've cleared the layout.

pages.title: Dice Merge
pages.creator: Pixel Saga Games
pages.description: Combine dice showing the same number in Dice Merge. A merge creates a die with a higher value and sets off a blast. Look at the boxes and other obstacles before deciding where to make your next combination. Use the explosions to break through the layout and clear the boxes.

pages.title: PacXon New Realms
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Claim sections of the board without getting caught in PacXon New Realms. Watch where enemies are moving before venturing out to take another chunk of territory. There are 192 stages across four locations, with character skins to unlock along the way. Change your route when an enemy gets too close.

pages.title: Food Card Sort
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Sort food cards onto matching plates in Food Card Sort. Look at the food shown on each card and decide which group it belongs with. Keep related foods together as you work through the 3D layout. Finish organizing the cards to move on to the next set.

pages.title: Block Team Deathmatch
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Choose a fight in Block Team Deathmatch, a first-person shooter built from pixel blocks. Try four-on-four Team Mode, fight on your own in Individual Mode, or focus on precision in Sniper Mode. Improve your equipment as you advance in rank and decide what weapon suits the next fight.

pages.title: Dynamons 7
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Explore Tall Pines and a bonus cave in Dynamons 7. Meet Jovani and recruit monsters such as Crocynos, Huango, Cybeenyx, and Aragonyx. Build a team and use special attacks or power-ups in one-on-one battles. Try different recruits as you explore the new areas and face other Dynamons.

pages.title: Two Blocks
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Connect two or more blocks of the same color in Two Blocks. Clearing a group changes the board, so look at which pieces can come together after your move. Check the level's objective before deciding what to remove. There are 80 stages with different goals and increasingly difficult layouts.

pages.title: Circle Shooter Master
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Run around a circular arena and fire at its boss in Circle Shooter Master. Gather materials and use them to build towers or defend roadblocks. Pick up items that fall on the track when you have a clear route to them. Keep watching the boss so you can avoid its attacks while dealing damage.

pages.title: Extreme Stunt Car Game
pages.creator: Play Like Crazy
pages.description: Take a car onto stunt tracks in Extreme Stunt Car Game. Pick a vehicle and work through routes that call for precise steering as well as speed. Look at the approach to each difficult section before you accelerate. Keep the car under control as you work your way through the levels.

pages.title: Pocket Dungeon Survivor
pages.creator: 2dragontails
pages.description: Survive a dungeon that fits on one screen in Pocket Dungeon Survivor. Fight enemies and keep track of the space you have when they close in. Improve your character with new attributes or abilities and unlock different skins. See how long you can hold out with the build you put together.

pages.title: Push My Chair
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Push office workers out of the arena in Push My Chair. Use the tools and weapons at hand to knock other chairs away while keeping your own seat inside the boundary. Try different chairs and weapons, and play on your own or against a friend in two-player mode.

pages.title: Drive Dead 3D
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Ram your opponent's car on hazardous platforms in Drive Dead 3D. Choose a vehicle, then watch for spinning blades, moving floors, cliffs, and explosives while you try to drive over the rival car. Check where each collision might send you. The arena is a threat to both drivers.

pages.title: Memory Speed
pages.creator: XiferGames
pages.description: Memorize figures and their order in Memory Speed. Study what appears and recall it before the short time limit expires. The challenge is remembering the sequence as well as the shapes themselves. See how many you can recall and compare your score on the global leaderboard.

pages.title: Giant Rush!
pages.creator: GameBake Ltd
pages.description: Grow stronger before a giant duel in Giant Rush! Run through the obstacle track and merge with blobs along the way. Bring that strength into the arena, where you can dodge attacks and fight the monster with a sword. What you collect during the run affects the fighter you bring to the duel.

pages.title: Glow Explosions !
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Start a chain reaction in Glow Explosions ! Tap a spot to create an explosion and wait for moving dots to touch its area. Every dot caught in the blast explodes in turn, so look for a place where several paths will meet. Remove every glow dot to finish the puzzle.

pages.title: Black Stallion Cabaret
pages.creator: PERSONA•GAMES
pages.description: Protect a train full of dancers in Black Stallion Cabaret. Travel between towns and merge workshop items to improve the train's weapons, dancers, and workshop. The battles happen automatically, and you have 30 seconds to stop a monster squad. Work on your equipment between fights so the train can keep touring.

pages.title: Run Away 3
pages.creator: GM Media
pages.description: Guide a lost alien through space tunnels in Run Away 3. Keep running and look for holes in the tunnel ahead so you can react before you reach them. Time your moves to stay on solid ground. Make it through the dangerous stretches and continue exploring the galaxy.

pages.title: Match Candy
pages.creator: TWO PLAYERS GAME STUDIO
pages.description: Line up three or more matching sweets in Match Candy. Bigger groups earn more points, so look for combinations that clear several pieces at once. The time available gets shorter with each level. Make your moves quickly enough to keep scoring while the next matches fall into place.

pages.title: Fallen Balls
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Launch the white ball and watch when it lines up with a yellow one in Fallen Balls. Tap again at the moment they overlap to destroy the yellow ball. The timing changes with each target, so keep an eye on their positions. Try to clear as many yellow balls as you can before missing.

pages.title: Super Spy Agent 46
pages.creator: TastyCherryGames
pages.description: Take on armed opponents as a cloned assassin in Super Spy Agent 46. Aim and fire with the mouse, switch weapons as the fight changes, and use grenades against groups of enemies. Move with WASD or the arrow keys and activate slow motion when you need more time to react.

pages.title: Spooky Camp Escape
pages.creator: playit-online
pages.description: Find a way out of a campsite in Spooky Camp Escape. Look through the area for objects that might help you leave and think about where you can use them. Check the surroundings again if you reach a dead end. The way out depends on what you discover around the camp.

pages.title: Princess Maid Academy
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Design a uniform for a palace maid in Princess Maid Academy. Try a black-and-white outfit or add touches of pink, blue, or lilac. Choose a white apron and a hairstyle to finish the look. Put together a style that fits someone working around the princess's receptions and events.

pages.title: Among U Red Imposter
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Strike without being seen in Among U Red Imposter. Look at where the other characters are before approaching your target. Wait until you have a chance to act without a witness, then move on to the next one. Getting close is only part of the challenge when someone else can catch you in the act.

pages.title: Among Them Find Us
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Find faded crewmates and impostors in Among Them Find Us. Search each picture carefully and click a character as soon as you spot it. There are ten figures hidden in every scene. Work through all six levels and look closely where the characters blend into the background.

pages.title: Line Road
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Guide a green ball through a white maze in Line Road. Aim for the matching green portal and watch how the ball rebounds when it hits a hedge. You have a limited number of collisions, so choose a route that keeps the ball away from as many walls as possible.

pages.title: Aquaform Marinett and Friends
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Color mermaid superheroes in Aquaform Marinett and Friends. Pick a picture of Ladybug or one of her friends in aqua form and choose how to color the details. Try bright shades or give each character a different palette. Take a screenshot if you'd like to share the finished picture.

pages.title: Touch Number
pages.creator: SUCCESS Corporation
pages.description: Tap numbers one at a time as quickly as possible in Touch Number. Scan for the next number before you move your finger so you can keep the sequence going. Choose between two modes and see how quickly you can get through the numbers without losing your place.

pages.title: Impossible Platform Game
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Get Dasher to the exit door in Impossible Platform Game. Use the arrow keys to guide him past enemies and hazards across 30 stages. Press R to restart if you want to try a section again, or Space to pause. Watch where you can land before moving into the next part of the level.

pages.title: Teacher Jigsaw Game
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Assemble scenes of teachers and students in Teacher Jigsaw Game. Pick from 12 classroom pictures and choose an easy, normal, or hard puzzle. Drag the fragments into place using details that carry across the edges. Try the same picture in another mode when you want a different challenge.

pages.title: Moon City Stunt
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Race against the clock on lunar roads in Moon City Stunt. Complete five stunt routes and unlock more vehicles, or take a car out in Free Driving mode. Experiment with the gravity settings and discover spiral roads, teleport points, and activities like space football and bowling.

pages.title: Clock Challenege
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Watch a rotating clock hand in Clock Challenege. Click or tap when the hand reaches the number the game asks for. A correctly timed move lets you hear the number spoken aloud. Keep watching the hand as you get ready for the next target on the clock face.

pages.title: Modern Bus Parking Advance Bus Games
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Maneuver a long coach through driving and parking missions in Modern Bus Parking Advance Bus Games. Look at how much space the bus needs before making a turn and line it up with the parking area. Use the driving view to judge the approach as you work through the missions.

pages.title: Ice Queen Tattoo Procedure
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Choose two tattoos for the Ice Queen in Ice Queen Tattoo Procedure. Pick one design for her arm and another for her hip, with options such as a snowman or a magical horse. Follow the game's steps to apply the designs. Add color to each tattoo before admiring the finished work.

pages.title: Train Simulator 2020
pages.creator: Matrix Info Service
pages.description: Take a train to its destination station in Train Simulator 2020. Drag the accelerator and brake to control its speed and keep an eye on signals and other trains. Use the camera icon to switch views when you need a different angle. Bring the train in safely to finish the level.

pages.title: Food And Drink Trucks Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Find matching truck pictures in Food And Drink Trucks Memory. Flip two tiles and remember their positions if the pictures differ. Use what you've seen to locate each pair when its partner comes up. Clear all four boards and see how few moves you can use to match every truck.

pages.title: Ladybug Hidden Hearts
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Find ten hearts in each picture in Ladybug Hidden Hearts. Check the scene closely before clicking, since repeated wrong guesses take five seconds off the timer. Find every heart before time runs out to continue. There are six pictures to search, with the hearts hidden in different parts of each scene.

pages.title: Circus Fun
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Jump past fire rings and other hazards in Circus Fun. Press Space or click the left mouse button to jump and pick up coins along the way. Watch how close the next ring is before taking off. Time each jump so you can keep going without colliding with the obstacles.

pages.title: Snowcross Stunts X3M
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Race down snowy courses in Snowcross Stunts X3M. Use the arrow keys to accelerate, brake, and lean as the slope changes. Work through the single-player stages or race opponents in multiplayer. Unlock skiers and snowboarders to try on the winter tracks.

pages.title: Pixel Artist
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Make pictures from colored squares in Pixel Artist. Choose an illustration, select colors, and fill in the pixels until the image is complete. Work through one area at a time to see how the individual squares come together. Choose another design when you're ready for a different picture.

pages.title: Traffic Run Christmas
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Cross busy roads in Traffic Run Christmas. Tap to drive and release to brake while other vehicles pass across your route. Wait for a gap before moving into the next crossing. Reach the finish without hitting traffic as you work through the holiday-themed courses.

pages.title: Santa Balls Fill
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Help Santa fill a bottle with balls in Santa Balls Fill. Look at the route the balls will take and work out how to get them to the opening. Use the mouse to solve each arrangement. Move on to the next puzzle when the balls reach the bottle.

pages.title: My Perfect Bride Wedding Dress Up
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Style a bride for her wedding in My Perfect Bride Wedding Dress Up. Browse hairstyles, makeup, and accessories with the mouse and see how they look together. Change individual details until the outfit suits the occasion. Put the finishing touches on the bride before the ceremony.

pages.title: Death Car Racing 2020 : Highway Racing Game
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Drive modified cars through highway traffic in Death Car Racing 2020 : Highway Racing Game. Watch the vehicles ahead and steer toward a gap before you reach them. Try the different cars as you work through the driving challenges. Keep the pace up while leaving enough room to get past traffic.

pages.title: 2020 Ducati Panigale Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild motorcycle pictures in 2020 Ducati Panigale Slide. Choose one of three images and one of the three modes, then shift the picture pieces into place. Compare parts of the bike and background to find where the sections belong. Finish the layout to reveal the full Ducati picture.

pages.title: Road Turn
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Send cars into traffic without causing a crash in Road Turn. Watch the vehicles going straight and click or tap when there's room for a car to turn. Judge how long the gap will stay open before sending the next car. Keep moving the waiting vehicles through when it's safe.

pages.title: Huge Sumos
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Push the other wrestler out in Huge Sumos. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, and double-press a direction to make a stronger move that way. Play alone or share the keyboard with a friend. Get into position before making a move that leaves you close to the edge.

pages.title: Game of Goose
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Roll dice and move a pawn in Game of Goose. Choose what to move on your turn and follow the board as the race unfolds. Play alone or share the screen with up to three other people. Work toward the end of the route and see which pawn arrives first.

pages.title: Spider Zombie
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Swing through obstacle courses in Spider Zombie. Shoot a web to stay in the air and watch where the next swing will carry you. Try to keep as many body parts as possible while getting around obstacles. Reach the destination to restore the zombie before taking on another level.

pages.title: Get Ready For Halloween
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Mia, Emma, and Bella shop for costumes in Get Ready For Halloween. Look through the available outfits and pick a style for each friend before the party. Try different combinations if you want the three costumes to stand apart. Get all three ready for the celebration.

pages.title: Airplane Parking Mania 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Fly and park an aircraft in Airplane Parking Mania 3D. Use WASD or the arrow keys to guide the plane and the mouse to manage its throttle. Give the aircraft room to turn as you approach the airport parking area. Finish by bringing it into the correct slot.

pages.title: Stickman Swing
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Tap to latch onto a hook in Stickman Swing. Use the swing to get through the air and release when you can reach the next stretch. Watch for obstacles and use bouncers when they help you get farther. Keep linking swings and jumps as the game gives you more levels.

pages.title: Modern Snake
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Collect eggs without running into your own body in Modern Snake. Drag to steer the snake around the play area and pick up eggs as you go. Watch the trail of segments behind its head before turning back across the board. See how many eggs you can gather in one run.

pages.title: Shadow Bike Rider
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Ride through 42 stunt courses in Shadow Bike Rider. Keep the bike under control on the route while trying moves that build your stunt score. Choose between two difficulty modes and see what you can do on each course. Each level tracks its own high score.

pages.title: Rabbit Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Aim colored bubbles at matching groups in Rabbit Bubble Shooter. Look for a shot that clears part of the board and opens up room for another. Try the two game modes and work through the different layouts. Check which colors remain before sending the next bubble.

pages.title: Connect Cute
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Look for matching animal pictures in Connect Cute. Select two identical tiles and check whether there's an open route between them. Clear a pair to open up paths through the layout, then look again for tiles you couldn't connect before. Keep working through the board until the available matches are gone.

pages.title: Eddie Adventures
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Help Eddie rescue his princess in Eddie Adventures. Run and jump past platforming hazards, use Space to shoot, and dash with X when you need to move quickly. Watch for the monsters that took her as you cross the levels. Make it through the different routes to continue the rescue.

pages.title: Rainbow Pony Caring
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Care for an injured pony in Rainbow Pony Caring. The rainbow pony has an accident while playing with her pet tortoise, so help her through the care activities first. Then choose an outfit to give her a new look. Take the pony from the accident to the finished makeover.

pages.title: Ludo Classic
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Roll dice and race your pieces home in Ludo Classic. Decide which pawn to move each turn based on what the roll allows. Share the game locally with one to three friends and watch where their pieces are on the board. Try to get your own pawns to the finish first.

pages.title: Traffic Crash
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Steer through highway traffic in Traffic Crash. Choose between two vehicles and try the three environments at different difficulty settings. Watch for cars in your path and leave room to get around them. Upgrade speed, health, or boost as you work on improving your score.

pages.title: Multiplayer Pong Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Meet another player for a game of Pong in Multiplayer Pong Challenge. Enter a nickname and wait for an opponent, then move your paddle to return the ball. Watch the direction it takes after each hit. Send it past the other paddle to score while keeping it from getting past yours.

pages.title: Zombie Killer
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Fight through 30 levels of a zombie outbreak in Zombie Killer. Watch where the undead are coming from and decide how to tackle each part of the city. The levels grow harder as you advance, so think through your approach before rushing in. Clear as many of the city's threats as you can.

pages.title: Go To Dot
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Send your dot through moving rings in Go To Dot. Watch the obstacles orbiting the center and wait for an opening before moving inward. Time the next move so your dot slips through without touching a hazard. See how often you can reach the center before a mistimed move ends the run.

pages.title: Numbers Memory Time
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Find matching number pictures in Numbers Memory Time. Choose a level mode and turn over tiles to see what they show. Remember where you saw each image so you can find its partner on a later turn. Match the remaining pairs to clear the board.

pages.title: Kung Fruit Fighting
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Slice red fruit while sparing blue vegetables in Kung Fruit Fighting. Watch each item before you swipe, since your fellow vegetables appear among the targets. Keep your cuts on the rival fruit as they cross the screen. The challenge is reacting quickly without striking the wrong clan.

pages.title: Wedding Preps
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Decorate two possible wedding venues in Wedding Preps. Visit the locations with a wedding planner and choose how to set up each one for the couple. Compare the finished venues after trying out the decorations. Decide where the wedding should take place once both locations are ready.

pages.title: 2048 Merge
pages.creator: Minijuegos.com
pages.description: Bring together at least three equal blocks in 2048 Merge. Arrange the numbered pieces so matching values combine into a larger number. Look for placements that keep room for your next move while opening up another group. See how high a score you can build and compare it on the charts.

pages.title: Connecting and Drawing
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Connect the dots to reveal a picture in Connecting and Drawing. Work from point to point and watch the outline take shape as you add lines. Keep going until you've joined all the dots. The finished drawing shows how the individual points fit together.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle: Bahamas
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Piece together 16 pictures of the Bahamas in Jigsaw Puzzle: Bahamas. Look for matching colors and details along the edges of each fragment as you rebuild the image. Start with a section you recognize and use it to place the surrounding pieces. Choose another tropical scene after finishing one.

pages.title: Freaky Brothers
pages.creator: Ixel Games
pages.description: Guide two brothers downward through traps in Freaky Brothers. Use the one-touch controls and watch how the pair moves as you descend. React quickly when the route narrows or another hazard appears below. See how far you can take both brothers and try to beat your previous score.

pages.title: Goalkeeper Challenge
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Make saves across ten increasingly difficult levels in Goalkeeper Challenge. Move the gloves with the mouse or your finger and watch where each shot is headed. Get into the ball's path before it crosses the line. Try to save as many attempts as you can as the shots get harder to stop.

pages.title: Princess Sorority Rush
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help Elsa, Ariel, and Moana get ready for new recruits in Princess Sorority Rush. Decorate the house with Elsa, help Ariel make colorful nonalcoholic drinks, and pick outfits with Moana. Work through the preparations so the rooms, refreshments, and hosts are ready when the guests arrive for the tour.

pages.title: Super Ball DZ
pages.creator: dgames
pages.description: Jump across platforms and fight enemies in Super Ball DZ. The adventure draws on battles from the Saiyan saga of Dragon Ball and takes you through 24 action stages. Watch the platform ahead as well as the opponents in your way. Clear the encounters to continue to the next level.

pages.title: Hidden Objects Pirate Treasure
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Search a mysterious island with Captain Angrybeard in Hidden Objects Pirate Treasure. Look for the items his crew needs to uncover the treasure and pick them out of each scene. Work quickly, but give the crowded areas a close look. Find all the hidden objects to move the hunt forward.

pages.title: Wedding Spring
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Get Christine ready for a spring wedding in Wedding Spring. Choose makeup and a hairstyle, then look for colors that work with the bridal theme. Pick a wedding dress and accessories once you've decided on the rest of the look. Bring the pieces together before she has to leave for the ceremony.

pages.title: Silly Ways to Die: Adventures
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: React quickly to keep characters alive in Silly Ways to Die: Adventures. Each minigame puts someone like Road Cone, Salami, Box Boom, or Mr. Palm in a different predicament. Work out what the scene needs and act before time runs out. Use the mouse or keyboard as the challenges change.

pages.title: Dove Bridesmaid Dolly Dress Up H5
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Open mystery boxes and dress Dove for a wedding in Dove Bridesmaid Dolly Dress Up H5. Put together a dress, shoes, and accessories from the options you find. Each look earns a rating, so try for a five-star outfit. Work toward more achievements as you put together different bridesmaid looks.
